verdict: A disagreement with Kev-27B marks a third of the jobs as uncertain, and neither model is reliable there. Against Gemma, elephant-1 is usually the one that is right.
note: elephant-1 here averages the label question over three option orders, as the screens' own source does, and gets 44 of 71 on its own.
